title: Health Education and Promotion (CPH1303): Main Exam, Mon 25th Nov, 2024 2.00pm
department: Department of Community Health, Epidemiology & Biostatistics
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO IN SECTION B

items.text: Describe the characteristics of an adult learner.
Explain the roles of a health educator.
Explain six principles of health education.
Describe three health education and promotion approaches.
Explain the role of non-verbal communication in passing messages.
Explain three basic principles for health promotion work/as explained in the Ottawa Charter
Discuss the justification for health promotion.
Describe the social cognitive theory in relation to behavior change.
Explain five common barriers to effective communication.
